description: Source code implementing the ImageFunctionHLSL class for generating HLSL code for image functions in the ANGLE project, including methods for handling image references, argument lists, size/load/store functions, and function header generation.

classes.name: ImageFunctionHLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for generating HLSL implementations of ESSL image functions, managing image function usage, and generating corresponding HLSL code.

classes.name: ImageFunctionHLSL::ImageFunction
classes.description: Struct representing an image function with properties like image type, internal format, method, and read-only status.

methods.name: GetImageReference
methods.description: Generates a string reference for an image based on its properties, outputting code to the sink.

methods.name: OutputImageFunctionArgumentList
methods.description: Outputs the argument list for an image function based on its properties.

methods.name: OutputImageSizeFunctionBody
methods.description: Outputs the body of the image size function, retrieving dimensions.

methods.name: OutputImageLoadFunctionBody
methods.description: Outputs the body of the image load function, retrieving image data.

methods.name: OutputImageStoreFunctionBody
methods.description: Outputs the body of the image store function, storing data into an image.

methods.name: useImageFunction
methods.description: Registers an image function usage with specific parameters and returns its generated name.

methods.name: imageFunctionHeader
methods.description: Generates HLSL function headers for all registered image functions.
